# KubeAgent

> AI-powered Kubernetes monitoring and auto-remediation CLI. Other tools tell you what broke — KubeAgent fixes it. Monitors clusters 24/7, diagnoses issues with AI (Claude), and applies safe remediations automatically. Install in 5 minutes. Built for solo DevOps engineers and small teams. Integrates with Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, PagerDuty, and custom webhooks. Privacy-first: no incident data is collected — all cluster data stays local.

- [Homepage](https://kubeagent.net): Product overview, features, pricing, and getting started
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/kubeagent): Install via `npm install -g kubeagent` or run with `npx kubeagent`

## Blog

- [Blog](https://kubeagent.net/blog/): Incident walkthroughs, agentic-diagnosis patterns, on-call economics, and product updates from the KubeAgent team
- [Blog RSS feed](https://kubeagent.net/blog/rss.xml): Subscribe via RSS / Atom reader

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://kubeagent.net/docs): Full CLI reference, notification setup, knowledge base guide, CI/CD API, and action safety tiers
- [Documentation (markdown)](https://kubeagent.net/docs.md): LLM-friendly markdown version of the full documentation

## CLI Commands

- [Installation](https://kubeagent.net/docs#install): Install globally with npm or run instantly with npx. Requires Node.js 22+ and kubectl
- [Quick Start](https://kubeagent.net/docs#quickstart): From zero to monitored cluster in under 5 minutes with `kubeagent onboard`
- [Login & Auth](https://kubeagent.net/docs#login): Browser-based OAuth login with device-code flow for headless/SSH machines
- [kubeagent status](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-status): One-shot cluster health check with JSON output for scripting
- [kubeagent onboard](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-onboard): Scan cluster topology and build the AI knowledge base
- [kubeagent watch](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-watch): Continuous monitoring loop — detects issues, diagnoses root causes, proposes and applies fixes
- [kubeagent check](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-check): One-shot cluster health check designed for CI pipelines — read-only by default, JSON output, exit codes (0 healthy, 1 issues found, 2 kubeagent error). Pairs with `kubectl rollout status` to gate deploys on actual system health, not just kubernetes-level acceptance
- [kubeagent diagnose](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-diagnose): On-demand AI diagnosis of current cluster issues
- [kubeagent query](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-query): Ask freeform questions about your cluster using AI with full cluster tool access
- [kubeagent scan-apps](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-scan-apps): Inventory OSS apps in the cluster, list affected workloads + ingress domains, flag CVEs and EOL versions; `--report` adds an AI-prioritized remediation report
- [kubeagent scan](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-scan): Match local project directories to cluster deployments
- [kubeagent notify](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-notify): Add, list, test, and remove notification channels from the CLI
- [kubeagent account](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cmd-account): Check plan, token balance, and usage

## Notifications

- [Slack](https://kubeagent.net/docs#slack): Real-time alerts with interactive approve/deny buttons for fix approval
- [Discord](https://kubeagent.net/docs#discord): Alerts via Discord webhook — no bot install needed
- [Microsoft Teams](https://kubeagent.net/docs#teams): Alerts via Incoming Webhook connector
- [Telegram](https://kubeagent.net/docs#telegram): Alerts and approvals via @KubeAgentBot with inline keyboard buttons
- [PagerDuty](https://kubeagent.net/docs#pagerduty): Trigger and auto-resolve PagerDuty incidents via Events API v2
- [Custom Webhooks](https://kubeagent.net/docs#webhooks): POST JSON payloads to any HTTP endpoint (Zapier, n8n, custom APIs)

## Advanced

- [Knowledge Base](https://kubeagent.net/docs#knowledge-base): Markdown files in ~/.kubeagent/kb/ that give the AI diagnoser context about your stack
- [Action Safety Tiers](https://kubeagent.net/docs#safety): Three tiers — safe (auto-execute), approval (requires human OK), never (proposed only)
- [CI/CD API](https://kubeagent.net/docs#cicd-api): POST cluster snapshots to /v1/checks/run, gate deployments on health findings

## API

- [Interactive API Docs](https://api.kubeagent.net/v1/docs): OpenAPI-powered interactive API explorer
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://api.kubeagent.net/v1/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification

## Pricing

KubeAgent offers four plans: Free trial (10,000 tokens), Growth at $29.99/mo (50,000 tokens), Pro at $79.99/mo (100,000 tokens), and Max at $199.99/mo (500,000 tokens). Extra credits available at $6 per 1M tokens. All plans include unlimited clusters and all notification channels.
